# The Open Public Health Journal

> > An open-access, peer-reviewed journal publishing rigorous public health research with transparent editorial processes and strict ethical standards.

The Open Public Health Journal is published by Bentham Science Publishers and operates as a gold open-access journal under Creative Commons licensing. The journal maintains high standards for academic integrity, peer review, and research ethics while making all published content freely available to readers worldwide.

## Key Topics

- open-access publishing
- peer-review process
- manuscript submission
- publication ethics
- research misconduct
- plagiarism prevention
- conflict of interest
- Creative Commons Attribution
- editorial policies

- editorial board
- gold open-access

## Publication Ethics & Integrity

- [Publishing Ethics](https://openpublichealthjournal.com/publishing-ethics.php): Publishing ethics standards and author/reviewer responsibilities
- [Plagiarism Prevention](https://openpublichealthjournal.com/plagiarism-prevention.php): Plagiarism prevention using iThenticate and academic integrity standards
- [Conflict of Interest](https://openpublichealthjournal.com/conflict-of-interest.php): Conflict of interest disclosure requirements and policies
- [Research Misconduct](https://openpublichealthjournal.com/research-misconduct.php): Research misconduct procedures and COPE compliance guidelines
- [Fabricating and Stating False Information](https://openpublichealthjournal.com/fabricating-and-stating-false-information.php): Policy on fabricated data, corrections, and retractions per COPE
- [Post Publication Discussions and Corrections](https://openpublichealthjournal.com/post-publication-discussions-and-corrections.php): Post-publication corrections, retractions, and editorial procedures
